title: Spec: OSCORE-by-default for all CoAP exchanges
description: Currently OSCORE is optional per-message. Change spec to make OSCORE mandatory for all CoAP exchanges (node-to-node and node-to-gateway-service). This is the single highest-leverage gateway hardening: a compromised gateway gets metadata only, never plaintext. Cleartext CoAP permitted only for: (1) well-known discovery (/.well-known/core), (2) EDHOC key exchange messages (bootstrapping), (3) explicitly opted-out broadcast telemetry (e.g. position beacons where the sender wants public visibility). Update spec/06-security.md and spec/07-transport-app.md. Cost analysis: ~10-15% more airtime for OSCORE overhead (nonce + tag), more CPU on constrained nodes for AES-CCM.
